question: According to the Census of India 2011, which state in India has the highest proportion of its population living in the urban areas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **Census of India 2011**, **Goa** has the highest proportion of its population living in urban areas.
 
• The urban population of Goa is** 62.17%** of the total population.
 
• Goa is followed by** Tamil Nadu** with an urban population of **48.45%.**
 
• **Kerala** has an urban population of **47.72%** and **Haryana** has an urban population of **34.91%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The term** "urban areas**" refers to areas with a population density of at least **400 persons per square kilometer** and with a minimum of **75% of the male working** population engaged in **non-agricultural activities.**
 
• Kerala is known for its **high literacy rate **and **quality healthcare facilities.**** **
 
• **Haryana** has a relatively **low urban population** compared to other states in India.
 
 
• The state is known for its** agricultural production** and **industrial development.**
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu** has a **high urban population** and is one of the most urbanized states in India.
 
 
• The state is known for its **manufacturing industries and tourism.**
 
 
 
• **Goa** has a high urban population due to its small **geographical area **and high tourism industry.
 
 
• The state is also known for its **beaches and nightlife.**
